---
title: "Penguin Bill Length by Species (R)"
author: "Anuoluwapo Akinkunmi"
date: 2026-09-21
---

Data: [palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER, available via the `palmerpenguins`
R package (CC0 licence).

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

penguins_clean <- penguins %>% filter(!is.na(bill_length_mm))
```

A quick look at the data:

```{r}
head(penguins_clean)
```

Average bill length by species:

```{r}
summary_table <- penguins_clean %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(mean_bill_length = round(mean(bill_length_mm), 1))

summary_table
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguin-bill-r
#| fig-cap: "Average bill length (mm) by penguin species."
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = species, y = mean_bill_length)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Bill length (mm)")
```

Chinstrap penguins have the longest average bill length among the
three species in this dataset.
